description: Synthetic PaddleOCR-VL layoutParsingResults payload: 3-page two-column English materials-science paper, 2x pixel coordinates (1224x1584) for 612x792 pt PDF pages. Every block bbox and label is hand-designed.

features.feature: authors line as text between doc_title and abstract

features.expect: text/body, semantic_role=abstract, translate=true, line_texts has 6 entries

features.feature: keywords line as text after abstract, before first heading
features.expect: text/body, translate=true: it is the first non-metadata text, so it STARTS the body flow (Keywords: is no longer a metadata cue)

features.feature: left-column body with two inline $...$ formulas + 2 inline_formula layout boxes
features.expect: body; 2 inline_formula segments; provider_inline_formula_bbox_count may be 2 if boxes lie inside the (tightened) bbox

features.feature: intra-page continuation head (same group_id/global_group_id, left col bottom)
intra-page continuation tail (right col top, starts lowercase)

features.expect: text/figure_caption bound to the preceding image (adjacent relation, previous)

features.feature: cross-page continuation head (right col bottom of page 1)
cross-page continuation tail (left col top of page 2)
features.expect: continuation_hint.role=tail, scope=cross_page; same continuation group id as pages[0] cont_cross_head

features.feature: body with 5 inline formulas but no matching inline_formula layout boxes
vision_footnote containing 'stable' about the figure (substring regression)
features.expect: INTENDED footnote_target=image/image_footnote; adapter test is `'table' in lowered`, so 'stable' may wrongly yield table_footnote
text/table_caption bound to the following table (next)

features.feature: chart (no src=; resolved via _box_ filename in markdown.images)

tricky_points: vision_footnote 'The SB-3 treated device remains stable ...' contains 'table' as a substring of 'stable'; resolve_vision_footnote uses `'table' in lowered`, so it is expected to be misclassified as table_footnote (intended: image_footnote).

Text blocks before the body-flow start (authors, affiliations: before the abstract) become front-matter metadata and are not translated; the Keywords line right after the abstract is classified body and translated.
Acknowledgement sentence with 'funded by' (<=40 words) is classified as metadata and not translated even though it is real prose.
Continuation pairs are tied by global_group_id; local group_id differs across pages for the cross-page pair. header/footer/number have block_order=null.
Page-1 continuation group is left-column-bottom -> right-column-top (column break within one page).
Chart has no src= in block_content; its asset is found only through the _box_x0_y0_x1_y1 filename match against markdown.images.
bbox is in px (2x); adapter heuristics (pseudo-line pitch, tighten_text_bbox) assume pt, so body bboxes may be tightened.
Two figure_title blocks neighbour one image/table each; Figure 1 caption sits between an image and a body text block (only the image is a compatible target).
